contracts.documented_proposition: network_cli host-key checking is enabled unless explicitly disabled
contracts.runtime_oracle: A correct pinned host key succeeds and a deliberately wrong host key is rejected.

contracts.documented_proposition: frr_facts accepts the config gather subset and returns ansible_net_config when config is gathered
contracts.runtime_oracle: facts_filters.yml must expose ansible_net_config on the live pinned FRR 10.7 lab; this is runtime evidence beyond the documented FRR 6.0 test scope.

contracts.documented_proposition: cli_config pushes text configuration over network_cli
contracts.runtime_oracle: After configure_fabric.yml, independently observed addresses, running configuration, peers and routes must match model-derived intent.

contracts.documented_proposition: cli_backup backs up device configuration over network_cli
contracts.runtime_oracle: backup_fabric.yml must create immutable per-node backups that can be selected, restored, persisted and verified after restart.
